content.title: Denver Outlasts Michigan In 2OT, Advances To NCAA Title Game - FloHockey
content.text: Denver is headed to the NCAA hockey championship game after outlasting Michigan in a double-overtime thriller in the Frozen Four semifinals.The Pioneers struck first on a Kyle Chyzowski goal, but Michigan answered with two first-period goals from Josh Eernisse and T.J. Hughes to take a 2-1 lead into the second. NCAA Men's Frozen Four Preview With FloHockey's Called Up PodcastRead The Latest 2026 NHL Draft Coverage On FloHockeySee FloHockey's Full Schedule Of GamesDenver pulled even early in the middle frame when Cale Ashcroft scored.Michigan moved back in front on a goal from Jayden Perron with 8:58 left in the third period, but Denver answered late when Clarke Caswell scored with 2:46 remaining to force overtime.After a tense first overtime and a second extra frame that tilted toward Michigan for long stretches, Denver finally got the winner from Kent Anderson in double overtime to close out a 4-3 classic.The Pioneers will face Wisconsin on Saturday night for the national championship.End Of Game: Denver Scores, WinsFinal (2OT): Denver 4, Michigan 3Kent Anderson scored in double overtime to send Denver to the national championship game.Michigan controlled much of the second overtime, but the Pioneers found the winner and will face Wisconsin on Saturday night.KENT ANDERSON CALLS GAME IN DOUBLE OT! 🚨#MFrozenFour x 🎥 ESPN2 / @DU_Hockey pic.twitter.com/UfKfLJOkns— NCAA Ice Hockey (@NCAAIceHockey) April 10, 2026Halfway Through Second OT - 2OT, 10:35Denver 3, Michigan 3Still tied, but Michigan has generated far more chances in the second overtime.Whether that pressure changes the outcome remains to be seen.Two Minutes Gone - 2OT, 18:01Denver 3, Michigan 3Two minutes are gone in the second overtime.Denver and Michigan have three shots apiece so far.Second Overtime Begins - 2OT, 20:00Denver 3, Michigan 3Another 20 minutes are on the clock, and the next goal wins.Denver and Michigan are going the distance.First Overtime EndsDenver 3, Michigan 3Still no winner.This one has turned into an overtime classic, and the next goal will end it.Denver Penalty - OT, 1:31Denver 3, Michigan 3Two minutes for tripping on Sam Harris of Denver.That means 1:06 of four-on-four hockey.Denver Power Play - OT, 2:28Denver 3, Michigan 3Two minutes for slashing on Will Horcoff of Michigan.Denver Shot Hits Crossbar - OT, 8:33Denver 3, Michigan 3Clarke Caswell nearly ended it in overtime, but his shot rang off the pipe.Halfway Through First OT - OT, 10:59Denver 3, Michigan 3Plenty of tension so far in overtime, but no goals yet.Johnny Hicks came up with a huge save, but there have not been many clean looks beyond that.— The NCHC (@TheNCHC) April 10, 2026TJ Hughes Shaken Up - OT, 18:07Denver 3, Michigan 3T.J. Hughes leaves the ice after a hit from Eric Jamieson.He appeared shaken up on the play.Overtime Begins - OT, 20:00Denver 3, Michigan 3Next goal wins.The winner will play Wisconsin for the national championship.Frozen Four Overtime RulesDenver 3, Michigan 3Overtime in the Frozen Four is simple: play until somebody scores. If the game is tied after 60 minutes, teams go to 20-minute sudden-death overtime periods at 5-on-5.There is no shootout and no 3-on-3 format. The first goal wins it.End Of RegulationDenver 3, Michigan 3Denver ties it late, and this one is headed to overtime.Next goal wins.Denver Ties It Up - 3rd, 2:46Denver 3, Michigan 3Clarke Caswell scores for Denver after a stick battle in front of the Michigan net, and the game is tied again with less than three minutes left.— Denver Hockey (@DU_Hockey) April 10, 2026Michigan Scores - 3rd, 8:58Denver 2, Michigan 3Michigan grabs the lead, and it may be the biggest goal of the night.Jayden Perron scores, and Hicks has little chance on the finish.— Big Ten Hockey (@B1GHockey) April 10, 2026Michigan Power Play - 3rd, 9:46Denver 2, Michigan 2Massive moment as Michigan gets its first power play of the game.Two minutes for cross-checking on Eric Jamieson of Denver.Denver Power Play - 3rd, 14:56Denver 2, Michigan 2Two minutes for boarding on Garrett Schifsky of Michigan.Hicks Crushed By Spence - 3rd, 16:07Denver 2, Michigan 2There is a massive collision between Malcolm Spence and Johnny Hicks, and Hicks is shaken up.The net is dislodged and the sequence turns chaotic in a hurry.It appears everyone is okay, and no penalties are being assessed.Denver Power Play - 3rd, 19:36Denver 2, Michigan 2Less than 30 seconds into the period, Denver gets a power play.Two minutes for tripping on Tyler Duke of Michigan.Third Period Begins - 3rd, 20:00Denver 2, Michigan 2Only 20 minutes remain in this Frozen Four semifinal.Michigan and Denver are tied 2-2.Second Period EndsDenver 2, Michigan 2Tied after two periods, and this has looked like one of the most evenly matched games of the NCAA tournament.There have been plenty of hits, plenty of shots and still another 20 minutes to decide it.Seven Minutes Left - 2nd, 7:02Denver 2, Michigan 2We are tied 2-2 with seven minutes left in the second period.Denver has found the equalizer this period, while Michigan has been held scoreless so far.It still feels like there are more goals coming in this one.Denver Scores - 2nd, 17:30Denver 2, Michigan 2The Pios do not score on the early power play, but they strike immediately after it ends.Only three minutes into the second period, Cale Ashcroft ties it at 2-2 for Denver.— NCAA Ice Hockey (@NCAAIceHockey) April 10, 2026Second Period Begins - Hughes finishes it after a rebound off the boards behind the net.With the way the puck kicked out, Hicks had almost no chance.Michigan takes the lead.— Big Ten Hockey (@B1GHockey) April 10, 2026Michigan Scores - 1st, 3:42Denver 1, Michigan 1Michigan scores off a faceoff in the Denver zone.The puck rockets past Johnny Hicks.Josh Eernisse is credited with the goal, and the game is tied.— Big Ten Hockey (@B1GHockey) April 10, 2026Denver Scores - 1st, 10:31Denver 1, Michigan 0The Denver power play ends, but it does not matter as Kyle Chyzowski scores the first goal of the game.Big goal for DU against the No. 1 overall seed.— NCAA Ice Hockey (@NCAAIceHockey) April 10, 2026Denver Power Play - 1st, 13:17Denver 0, Michigan 0Two minutes for holding on Tyler Duke of Michigan.DU gets its best chance so far to score.Denver Shooting Early - 1st, 16:27Denver 0, Michigan 0Denver has six shots already to Michigan's three.Still no goals on either side.Game Begins - 1st, 20:00Denver 0, Michigan 0Michigan and Denver are underway in the second Frozen Four semifinal.The winner will face Wisconsin in the national championship game.— The NCHC (@TheNCHC) April 10, 2026Frozen Four 2026 ScheduleThursday, April 9Wisconsin 2, North Dakota 1Denver 4, Michigan 3 (2OT)Saturday, April 115:30 p.m. ET - Denver vs. Wisconsin - Division I Men's National Championship Game - ESPNHow To Watch The Frozen Four 2026The 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four will be broadcast on ESPN2, with the final being broadcast on ESPN.
